title: The pitch, the ad and the morning after
lede: Quibi’s own channels and shows are gone from the app stores, but the sales pitch survives: the founders on CNBC a year before launch, the CES keynote, the Super Bowl spot, and the same two people explaining the shutdown nine months later.

videos.title: “Bank Heist,” the Super Bowl LIV spot
videos.caption: Aired February 2, 2020, two months before the service existed. A getaway driver promises to arrive “in a Quibi,” meaning less than ten minutes.[^24] USA Today’s Ad Meter ranked it fourth from bottom of 62 ads.[^25] A third-party upload made on the day of the game.

videos.title: The Quibi keynote at CES 2020
videos.caption: Whitman and Katzenberg’s full presentation in Las Vegas on January 8, 2020, where Turnstyle, the prices and the April 6 launch date were announced.[^26][^27] From the CES channel, uploaded January 15, 2020.

videos.title: CNBC: Whitman and Katzenberg explain Quibi, a year early
videos.caption: A ten-minute interview on “Squawk on the Street,” uploaded by CNBC on June 19, 2019, ten months before launch. The case for paid short-form video, in the founders’ own words.

videos.title: CNBC: “Shutting down operations was most honorable choice for shareholders”
videos.caption: The founders on CNBC’s “Squawk Alley” on October 22, 2020, the morning after the announcement, explaining why they chose to stop and return cash.[^1]

videos.title: Good Morning America: “Billion dollar short form streaming start up Quibi shuts down”
videos.caption: ABC’s morning-show report on the closure, uploaded October 22, 2020.

videos.title: Ordinary Things: “The Dumpster Fire Failure of Quibi”
videos.caption: A fourteen-minute independent retrospective, uploaded November 12, 2020, while the app was still running out its last weeks. Its figures and opinions are the uploader’s; ours are in the sections above.

note: No official launch trailer for the service could be found on a channel we could verify; the CES keynote is the fullest surviving record of how Quibi presented itself.
